column2: I was worried when it got cloudy.
The leaves burn their last life.
I could walk all day here.
Why would you need to sneak?
I love to swim in the sea.
Then I'll go swim by myself.
Where sea meets sky, it's a bit hazy,
It's no fun to ride one alone…
『I'd like to try a noisy Ferris wheel』
No gossip, no backbiting up here…
『My lucky color's brown. Let's eat curry!』
so I was a bit worried.
I don't pay attention to that.
I may not be up to the job,
but hang on a little bit…
a fancy goods shop, of course!
I like zoos and stadiums too!
You're like a drunk at a picnic.
『Then this place is a million volts!』
Must've been so hard to paint!
Then I guess I had no talent!
I did try my best, though)
『You want the fancy goods shop, right?』
Just where I wanted to go!
『Girls proud of their legs, I guess』
Girls with nice figures wear them.
I'd love to try one just once!
I want to buy it all!
I'd love to live among cute things!
I hope they make slanted eyes,
They should make a hundred faces
I was going to buy it.
It wasn't what I expected, but
I thought it was pretty fun!
But I was hoping to see it
Let's hurry in and book a room!
I can't pick what to sing!
『Lucky if this is all it takes』
Your stress is too much even
『They look it, but they can be aggressive』
『Yeah! But they probably sleep all day』
We came all this way, let's go in!
it doesn't feel like a theme park!
I'd love to ride home on one!
Guess I'm the odd one out.
so I just wanted to join in!
it doesn't have to be a princess,
I just want to join in.
『They have a net, so it's safe』
You don't seem to enjoy it.
But it looks so fun, doesn't it?
I want to try it too!
『Just a bunch of big trees to me』
Guess only I was having fun.
『Why do you want to feed them?』
That stand sells it, I think.
they sell carp food right there!
『Not like I pay the water bill…』
Maybe it reuses the pond water.
I'm not saying I want to drink it!
